description: This Java source file defines a custom layout class `ShadowLayout` that extends `RelativeLayout`. The class provides functionality to paint a drop shadow behind its child views, with adjustable shadow depth which affects the size and opacity of the shadow. It manages the creation of a bitmap representing the shadow and draws it behind child views during the `onDraw` method.

classes.name: ShadowLayout
classes.description: A custom layout that paints a drop shadow behind all its child views, with support for shadow depth animation.

methods.name: ShadowLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing the ShadowLayout with different parameter sets.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes paint properties and creates the shadow bitmap with a rounded rectangle, setting up the parameters for drawing shadows.

methods.name: setShadowDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth of the shadow, adjusting the opacity and translation offset accordingly, and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the shadow bitmaps behind each visible child view based on the current shadow depth.
